result.title: StoBasket: Joint Upsell and Cross-Sell Optimization for Contribution Margin
result.summary: Retail recommenders rank relevance, but retailers earn contribution margin: an upsell earns the margin difference over the item it replaces, whereas a cross-sell earns its full margin. We introduce joint stochastic basket editing, a formulation in which one policy selects replacement and addition offers for an existing basket, values them by expected incremental contribution margin, and couples them through displayed-offer, accepted-offer, and joint-acceptance response channels. To our knowledge, it is the first formulation in which upsell and cross-sell responses are coupled; prior separable treatments are its zero-coupling special case. In real-data-calibrated simulations on five public basket datasets, StoBasket captures essentially all attainable offer margin: within 0.5% in every default-price setting and within 0.7% when the true response lies outside its model family. Correct economic accounting is the broadest gain: margin-weighted popularity leaves up to 11% of attainable margin unrealized, and a published next-basket recommender leaves 11-52%. Joint selection adds 10.2% of attainable margin on Instacart, where premium tiers and add-ons are strongly linked. When offers pay only together, the best heuristics lose 64% while exact search stays within 0.5%. For a structured subclass, we characterize when staged policies fail and give an exact optimizer that solves every tested real basket in 0.13 ms median and at most 111 ms. Profit saturates long before prediction accuracy: a correctly structured predictor trained on 5,000 randomized sessions comes within 0.06% of perfect prediction, while a signal-free one loses 38%. The same estimates yield a decision-aware market-basket analysis whose cost does not grow with association order.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 StoBasket，将零售购物篮的向上销售与交叉销售统一为一个联合随机「购物篮编辑」策略，以期望增量贡献毛利为目标建模显示、接受与联合接受响应通道，并在五个公开购物篮数据集上用校准模拟验证其接近最优的收益。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究对象是零售推荐与贡献毛利优化，其「响应通道耦合」等概念与 LVR 的 latent 状态、视觉证据或多模态推理缺少实质联系，未见可供借鉴的线索。
